---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an SDK capability or developer-experience improvement
---

## Problem

Describe the developer task and what makes it difficult with the current SDK.

## Proposed behavior

Show the smallest useful API or CLI example and its expected result. State relevant lifecycle, error, cancellation, or privacy implications.

## Alternatives

Explain existing workarounds and why the responsibility belongs in the SDK rather than an adapter or application.
